title: Protocol to visualize ion channel trafficking in acutely isolated rodent neurons using live-cell immunocytochemistry
protocol: Apply oxygenated treatment solution carefully to each dish.
Let the treated cells sit for 30 min at 21°C - 23°C.
Pipette 200 μl of treatment solution out of each well.
Pipette slowly 200 μL of the appropriate oxygenated blocking solution into each well.
Let sit for 30 minutes at 21 °C − 23 °C.
Begin pipetting the new solution in prior to completing the removal of the old solution to prevent the well from drying out.
Pipette slowly (each plate should take around 20 seconds) to avoid dislodging loosely attached cells and keep some small volume of liquid in the well at all times.
Pipette out 200 μL of blocking solution from each well.
Pipette in 200 μL of the appropriate oxygenated primary antibody solution into each well.
Let sit for 30 minutes at 21 °C − 23 °C.
Carefully add 2 mL of the appropriate oxygenated 1× PBS to each dish.
Remove and repeat a second time.
Remove the 1× PBS from the outside of each dish, being careful not to disturb the well.
Pipette in 2 mL of cold (4 °C) 4% PFA to each well.
Let sit for 20 min at 2-23 °C.
Critical: Wear appropriate PPE when handling and disposing of 4% PFA.
Remove the 4% PFA from the outside of each dish.
Pipette in 2 mL of PBST, remove and repeat a second time with PBST.
Carefully remove 200 μL of PBST from each well.
Pipette in 200 μL of secondary antibody solution.
Let sit for 60 min at 2-23 °C.
Remove the 4% PFA from the outside of each dish.
Pipette in 2 mL of PBST.
Remove and repeat a second time with PBST.
Wash with 2 mL of 1× PBS.
Remove and repeat a second time with 1× PBS.
Carefully remove 200 μL from each well.
Apply 2–3 drops of antifade solution (Citifluor AF-1).
Cover the plates with dish lids.
Store at 4 °C in an opaque container until ready to image.
